# AI Agent Engineering

**Building the Agent Harness from Scratch to Production**

Fifteen chapters and thirteen appendices build a complete production agent system: execution loops and state graphs, tool registries and context engineering, circuit breakers and sandboxes, signed checkpoints, CI gates and distributed tracing — with 22 Jupyter notebooks and 64 tested code blocks.

![AI Agent Engineering](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AhmedAlmaghz/MBAssets/main/books/agent-harness-engineering/cover.png)

## What you will learn

- **The Modern Foundation** — 2 chapters & appendices
- **Anatomy of an Agent** — 3 chapters & appendices
- **Engineering the Harness** — 4 chapters & appendices
- **Advanced Patterns & Multi-Agent Systems** — 2 chapters & appendices
- **Test Harness, Evals & Production** — 2 chapters & appendices
- **Production Capstone Projects** — 2 chapters & appendices
- **Appendices and Reference** — 14 chapters & appendices
